priya: Heads-up — during the q4_0 14B bring-up I keep hitting a weird "stutter" in sampling where generation pauses for ~70-120ms every ~12 tokens. Repro on longform QA synth and a subset of C4 prompts. Anyone seen this pattern before? :thinking:

alex: can you paste the runtime logs near the pause? also which sampler settings (top_p/temp/beam)?

priya: sampler was `temp=0.9 top_p=0.92`. workload is steady single-client stream at 20 req/s. pasted excerpt from gpu0 log: ```
[2024-11-14 14:03:11.223] token_emit idx=12 latency=9.2ms
[2024-11-14 14:03:11.232] token_emit idx=13 latency=118.7ms  <-- pause
[2024-11-14 14:03:11.351] token_emit idx=14 latency=8.5ms
[2024-11-14 14:03:11.360] token_emit idx=15 latency=7.9ms
[2024-11-14 14:03:11.368] token_emit idx=16 latency=121.1ms <-- pause
```

maria: those periodic spikes smell like batching alignment or a fallback happening every N tokens. what are the dynamic batch/window settings?

priya: batch window is `max_wait_ms=4 dynamic_batch=true`, and we keep `kvcache_prefill=true`. On Dedicated hardware (A100-80GB). Not seeing gpu mem thrash.

sam: could also be speculative-decoding interaction. if speculative prober triggers a fallback for certain token positions we occasionally wait for the verifier path. Any logs from speculative layer?

priya: added speculative debug, saw `spec_probe: fallback=true` at the same indices as pauses. Short trace: ```
spec_probe idx=13 cost_delta=0.08 fallback=true reason=beam_conflict
spec_probe idx=26 cost_delta=0.09 fallback=true reason=beam_conflict
```

leo: interesting. beam_conflict suggests a mismatch between fast-path sampler and validator model. Are you using two different quant variants (fast q4_0 vs verify q8_0 cpu)?

priya: yup — fast path = q4_0 (fp16 kernels), verify path = q8_0 on CPU-only verifier (cheap). looks like the verifier occasionally triggers and we wait on it. but why periodic every 12 tokens?

alex: maybe the verifier policy is tied to token positions (e.g., every Nth token we run a safety/consistency probe). check rollout config: `verifier_interval=12`?

priya: omg that's it — config default was `verifier_interval=12` from the early on-board patch. I must've missed it.

maria: that explains deterministic periodicity. still, fallback cost is high because verifier is CPU q8 path. Solution: either do asynchronous verification (don't block), or make verifier q4_0 GPU so it's fast, or lower verifier frequency.

eval-bot: quick eval on 200 holdout QA pairs comparing fast-only (no verifier) vs current (verifier@12):
- accuracy (QA-acc): fast-only 78.9% vs current 78.6% (delta -0.3)
- fluency score (LLR): fast-only +0.9
- hallucination flag rate: fast-only 0.7% lower
- paired bootstrap p=0.11 (not significant)

sam: so verifier buys tiny quality improvements at fairly high latency cost. if we convert verifier to async shadow-check we get quality but avoid pauses. can we run shadow verifier on same GPU in batch?

leo: we could run verifier as low-prio GPU queue in q4_0 — then its latency to complete will be comparable and not block. Need to check memory/slot budget.

priya: for bring-up immediate action: set `verifier_interval=0` (disable), add a canary that runs verifier async on 1% of requests, and add an A/B to measure downstream hallucination metric.

alex: also add a synthetic microburst test to CI where we replay steady stream plus single-request jitter; this uncovered the issue here because production had modest jitter.

maria: methodology note: for A/B use paired prompts, compute win-rate and bootstrap CI, and also record per-token latency distribution (p50,p90,p99) and count of periodic spikes. We should include deterministic seeds for sampling where possible (or stateless sampling hooks) so comparisons are stable.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-1427 with repro steps and logs, assigned to @sam and @leo. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll repro locally with verifier in async GPU mode and run the 1k-prompt eval set. If results look neutral for quality but latency improves, we switch to async by default.

priya: thanks — lesson: small verification policies can create rhythmic stalls. added to onboarding checklist: verify `verifier_interval` and whether verifier path runs on CPU vs GPU.

alex: nice find. can we add a quick lint in the model-onboard pipeline to flag verifier-on-cpu + verifier_interval>0?

maria: yeah I'll drop that lint into the onboarding CI today.

priya: will follow up with the A/B numbers once sam runs the async variant. thanks everyone :rocket:
